products.title: Wilson Blade V4 2026 - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON BLADE V4 2026 - The new Blade arrives renewed, with a slight design change and with improved technologies to achieve a more balanced and durable racket. Without a doubt, one of the Wilson rackets with the best quality-price ratio. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The WILSON BLADE V4 2026 arrives completely renewed to continue being one of the brand's most balanced padel rackets. Its teardrop format helps us achieve that balance so desired by players.

It is a racket that transmits a lot of confidence both from the back of the court and in the net game.

PLAYER TYPE

Designed for players looking for an excellent compromise between control, power and comfort, it offers a very versatile behavior that adapts to any match situation.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The materials in the WILSON BLADE V4 2026 are quality. We find a combination of carbon fiber and fiberglass. With this duo, a balanced, flexible feel and good durability are achieved.

Its rubber is firm Foam, a hard and stable rubber that increases the power in our blows, but also leaving us with the characteristic softness of foam rubber.

Its technologies are: a rough surface Spin Effect Texture, which facilitates the generation of effects. Its C2 Tubular Construction structure, made entirely of carbon. In addition, the Anti-Fragile Edge protector reinforces the frame against bumps and scratches, while the Duo Grid Hole system optimizes the performance of the hitting surface.

products.title: Head Extreme Pro 2026 - Head
products.description:
HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 - We present the most powerful racket in the Extreme collection, a true attacking machine that stands out for its explosive punch and firmness in offensive hits. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 arrives with a diamond format and high balance, a configuration that favors power and allows you to make the most of the inertia of the racket. It concentrates greater inertia in the upper part, favoring shots and blows above the head.

PLAYER TYPE

If you are one of those who look for any opportunity to get up to the net and finish the point, this Extreme Pro has a lot to offer you. It is a padel racket with a clearly offensive character, one of those that brings out its best version when we play with determination and hit with good technique.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 stands out for its UD Carbon HS carbon construction that provides rigidity, while the Power Foam core provides a fast and energetic response. In addition, it incorporates the new Auxetic 2.0 technology to improve the sensations and connection with the ball in each impact.

It also incorporates Extreme Spin technology, a 3D roughness that facilitates spin, and Optimized Sweet Spot, which optimizes the distribution of the holes to improve the useful hitting area.

On the other hand, we continue with the Tailored Frame construction to help achieve a more consistent response, while the Soft Cap+ system improves grip comfort, reducing vibrations.

products.title: Head Extreme Pro - Arturo Coello - Head
products.description:
HEAD EXTREME PRO - ARTURO COELLO - The new jewel in the crown of Head Padel. Worn by Arturo Coello, the world number 1. Racquet of incredible power, diamond shape and with the best technologies. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Discover your wildest side with the new HEAD EXTREME PRO - ARTURO COELLO, which will be the racket used by the number 1 in the world, Arturo Coello, one of the young promises of this sport who in such a short time as a professional has managed to reach the top. This 2023 season and those to come, he will use this weapon, the Extreme Pro model, a diamond-shaped, aggressive racket, with high balance that generates extreme power in each hit.

PLAYER TYPE

We recommend this racket only for those players with an aggressive profile and who control attacking rackets. It is a racket that will surely take us to the next level in terms of power. If you play both forehand and backhand and are looking for the best power, this is yours.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

We are going to know in detail everything that one of the best Head rackets brings: the HEAD EXTREME PRO - ARTURO COELLO.

As we have already mentioned, it is the official racket of the professional player Arturo Coello, a new racket launched by Head to highlight the aerial power of its players. The diamond shape is the true protagonist, a high balance format but respecting a large sweet spot to also have good control. Its weight is 370 grams, which is ideal for delivering high power to blows.

Among its materials and technologies, we highlight Auxetic technology, which gives us greater power on impact and softness in blows when we want control.

In its framework we highlight Graphene, which is the material responsible for providing us with the greatest durability in that area. For its part, in the plane area we have a hybrid composition that combines carbon fiber and fiberglass, on a Power Foam rubber.

It is also rough. It incorporates Extreme Spin technology, to make our blows have more effect.

PLAY STYLE

On the court, the HEAD EXTREME PRO - ARTURO COELLO is an extreme racket as its name indicates. Indicated to secure the points as close to the network as possible. For players who want to get the best vipers and finishes.

In defense it also performs great, as Head emphasizes this by incorporating flexible materials such as Foam rubber in the core.

products.title: Black Crown Special Master - Black Crown
products.description:
BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER - Gama alta, con un gran control y tacto muy agradable.

 INTRODUCCIÓN DE LA PALA

La BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER siendo una pala muy polivalente, se nos presenta como una de las que más control nos va a aportar a nuestro juego.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Para jugadores que busquen un plus en golpes de calidad, un magnifico manejo y adaptable desde nivel avanzado.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

Empezando por su formato, la BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER es una pala con un formato lágrima, en búsqueda siempre de un muy buen equilibrio y priorizando un poco más el control, con una distribución de 60% control y 40% potencia.

Presenta unas caras en carbono 12K que aseguran una respuesta con mucha resistencia, combinadas con un núcleo con goma SSB Black Eva, que se trata de una goma blanda muy agradable, siendo este modelo, la Black Crown con un tacto más blando en este 2024. También presenta una rugosidad tipo arena, consiguiendo así una gran facilidad para conseguir golpes con efecto.

En cuanto a los marcos, tienen un doble tubular en carbono, haciéndola muy resistente y estable.

Además, con la tecnología Extended Sweet Spot Area, vamos a tener un punto dulce ampliado para tener una mayor superficie de golpeo y centrar mejor la bola.

ESTILO DE JUEGO

El estilo de juego que más casa con esta pala, es en el cual busques mucho control sin dejar pasar desapercibido el ataque, ya que también responde con mucha potencia.

products.englishDescription:

PLAYER TYPE

For players looking for a plus in quality shots, magnificent handling and adaptable from an advanced level.

Starting with its format, the BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER is a padel racket with a teardrop format, always seeking a very good balance and prioritizing control a little more, with a distribution of 60% control and 40% power.

It has 12K carbon faces that ensure a very resistant response, combined with a core with SSB Black Eva rubber, which is a very pleasant soft rubber, this model being the Black Crown with a softer feel in 2024. It also has a sand-like roughness, thus making it easy to hit hits with spin.
